name: python
description: ruff with the rule families that catch agent habits, mypy strict, and import-linter layer contracts.

merge.how: Set root_package to the repository's top-level package and list its real layers, highest first. Mark a layer optional by listing only layers that exist.
If pyproject.toml already has [tool.ruff], move the pack's settings under it (prefix each table with tool.ruff.) and delete ruff.toml; ruff ignores ruff.toml when pyproject.toml configures it.

baseline: Run `ruff check --add-noqa .` once to mark existing violations, then ratchet the markers: add {"id": "python-noqa", "pattern": "# noqa", "files": ["*.py"]} to .agents/ratchet.json and run ratchet.mjs update. For mypy, list legacy modules in a [mypy-<module>] section with ignore_errors = True and ratchet the count of those sections the same way.
